subject: Startups
title: Offer Letters and Employment Agreements
description: A quick, practical guide to Offer Letters and Employment Agreements.

hook.text: A verbal job offer isn't binding. An incomplete offer letter is a lawsuit waiting to happen. Details matter enormously.

buildup.text: Every offer letter should include: title, salary, equity, start date, reporting line, at-will status, and IP assignment.

discovery.text: YC provides standard templates through Clerky. Using tested legal templates saves thousands in legal fees.

twist.text: Promises made verbally—'You'll get more equity later'—are often forgotten. If it's not in writing, it doesn't exist.

climax.text: Clean legal foundations prevent disputes. Spending $500 on proper documents now saves $50,000 in litigation later.

punchline.text: Write it down, sign it, file it. That's employment law.

quiz.question: What should always be included in a startup offer letter?
options: Title, salary, equity, at-will status, and IP assignment
